files.label: UI soft click
files.use_when: tiny UI selection, subtle word/card acknowledgement
files.avoid_when: major reveal, scene transition, or emotional beat
files.prompt: Very soft modern UI click, one-shot, clean high-end mobile app tap, no harsh transient, no reverb, quiet.

files.label: Card pop
files.avoid_when: every caption word or dense rapid list
files.prompt: Soft rounded card pop sound, one-shot UI motion, gentle rubbery pop with tiny air, premium app interface, not cartoonish.

files.label: Check tick
files.use_when: criterion passes, checklist confirms, positive gate result
files.prompt: Small satisfying checkmark tick, clean glassy UI confirmation, one-shot, bright but soft, no melody.

files.label: Line draw
files.use_when: path, connector, underline-free progress line, graph stroke draws
files.prompt: Subtle whoosh of a thin line being drawn across a glass interface, one-shot, airy, clean, no impact, no noise burst.

files.label: Meter fill
files.use_when: ring/meter/count progress fills or reaches a threshold
files.prompt: Smooth circular meter filling sound, rising soft UI shimmer, restrained premium health app, one-shot, no alarm.

files.label: Filter pass
files.use_when: rule passes, item clears the 2 of 3 gate
files.prompt: Soft positive filter pass sound, clean digital gate opens, small warm chime tail, one-shot, premium and quiet.

files.label: Filter reject
files.use_when: item fails a rule, warning without red/harsh error
files.prompt: Gentle muted reject sound, soft low thud with tiny UI click, not alarming, no buzzer, no distortion.

files.label: Callout ping
files.use_when: small annotation/callout points to an object or metric
files.prompt: Short soft callout ping, clean interface notification, one-shot, rounded and quiet, no phone ringtone.

files.label: Page swipe
files.use_when: scene wipe, plate to B-roll, CTA document/mockup appears
files.prompt: Soft page swipe transition, paper and air movement blended with clean UI whoosh, one-shot, no snap, no harsh highs.

files.label: Soft impact
files.use_when: major diagnosis/reveal, hook beat, important warning
files.avoid_when: minor UI micro motion or B-roll
files.prompt: Soft cinematic impact for social video, low rounded thump with tiny air, controlled, no distortion, no trailer boom.
